answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 5063 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to know that the name " ERUM" for a girl is right to choose? what does it mean ? nd my second question is that is it necessary for a girl to attach her husband's name after her name as she get married, what is islamic guidance in that view? Question: assalamoalaikum, I want to know that the name " ERUM" for a girl is right to choose? what does it mean ? nd my second question is that is it necessary for a girl to attach her husband's name after her name as she get married, what is islamic guidance in that view? thanks. Answer ID: 5063 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 373/373=M/1429) It is not right to name one ?Erum? since it means: to perish, to be barren etc. Also, Erum is a nation destroyed by Allah, the nation ?Aad? ( عاد ) belongs to them, as mentioned in Quran. Therefore, it is better to name her ?Maryam? or some other name having good meaning. (2) It is not necessary for a woman to suffix her husband?s name, as per the Shariah she is not bound to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
